items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: Ray Badouk, Jules Badouk, and a kid by the name of Bill Krieger was a clarinet player. Worked in that band.

ctx.x: Well, Ray Badouk, Jules Badouk, and a kid by the name of Bill Krieger was a clarinet player. Worked in that band. And Bill Krieger stole the orchestration on High Society out of the Library of Congress in Washington. You see, they worked there, they worked all the way from, from, from Birmingham to Washington. That was their territory. You know, all the bands in the North States had their own territory. Well, that was not, I'll nail this territory from, from Birmingham to, to Washington. And Bill Krieger stole…
I've heard too, it was in the Susan Marsh, but I never could find the Susan music part.
